items.name: FileStats
items.summary: File-level statistics for a table version: total file count, size, and histogram.

methods.name: file_size_histogram
methods.summary: Returns the size distribution of active files, if available.

methods.name: num_files
methods.summary: Returns the number of active [`Add`](crate::actions::Add) file actions in this table version.

methods.name: table_size_bytes
methods.summary: Returns the total size of the table in bytes (sum of all active [`Add`](crate::actions::Add) file sizes).
